'''Jerru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] craftsman who was highly skilled in the ancient craft of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-forming. Jerru plied his trade aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]], [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], where he additionally acted as a front for [[Poliss]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] recruiter.
